research_question.primary: Can a model acquire the registered unit-safe reactive-controller capability and produce an independently verified artifact under a capability-first condition?
secondary: Which L-levels can be independently verified?
Does structural transfer succeed on a fresh task?
Can the demonstrated capability be reconstructed from a stripped context bundle?

project.domain: physical-unit semantics and event/guard state-machine semantics
project.required_output: independently executable controller implementation satisfying the registered task semantics
success_criteria: bounded reachability and guard analysis produce valid reports
structural transfer succeeds on the registered transfer task
unsupplied extension preserves prior behavior and passes fresh tests

condition.name: capability-first
registered_resources: permitted external references logged in resource ledger

terrain.t3_ladder: Must be structurally justified before use.
terrain.t5_intervention: Must be registered before any destruction claim.

trajectory.verification: Every claimed level requires Verification A and Verification B.

q2b.transfer_task: Must be structurally different from the training/build task and must not supply its solution procedure.
q2b.reconstruction_task: Must use a stripped context bundle and a separately identified evaluator.

contamination_controls.model_context_restrictions: no investigator-only context during learner phase

falsification: independent verification fails after verifier validity is established
transfer fails under the registered structural-change rule
retention fails the registered stability rule
reconstruction fails under the registered stripped-context condition
resource normalization invalidates the planned interpretation
amendment_rule: Any post-registration change is dated, justified, versioned, and linked to affected runs.
